Portfolio.description: My web portfolio, designed as a desktop view.
points: Developed in native JS and Tailwind CSS.
Utilized modular approach for ease of feature-expansion.

HPDF.description: JVM Application implementing basic PDF manipulation tools.
points: Utilized Kotlin/Java, implementing an MVC-I architecture to develop an open-source PDF manipulation program.
Leveraged Apache PDFBox Library to manipulate PDFs.
Utilized Jetpack Compose and Kotlin to develop a native Android party game app.
Learned about MVVM architecture, process death and data persistence.
Maintained a non-relational local database storing user information in JSON.

McMaster Self-Serve Kiosk.description: Award-winning (Ember Hackathon @ McMaster University) Python MVP of a self-serve kiosk application.
points: Used KivyMD and Python to develop an MVP application for a self-serve kiosk concept.
